en.headline: PBOC issues RMB 60 billion of six-month bills in Hong Kong
en.dek: The People's Bank of China dated a new batch of central bank bills for Monday after a tender last week that drew more than twice the amount on offer.
body: The People's Bank of China issued RMB 60 billion of six-month central bank bills in Hong Kong on Monday, according to tender results released by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority.
The notes carry issue number BCHKFP26041, with an issue date of 28 September 2026 and a maturity date of 29 March 2027, or the closest coupon payment date. The tender was held on 23 September.

Applications totalled RMB 127.035 billion against the RMB 60 billion on offer. The average accepted coupon rate was 1.30 per cent, with accepted bids ranging from 1.15 per cent to 1.37 per cent. About 36.74 per cent of bids at the highest accepted rate were allotted.

The Monetary Authority published the figures on behalf of the People's Bank of China. Regular issuance of renminbi central bank bills in Hong Kong is part of the onshore central bank's management of offshore renminbi liquidity.

zh.headline: 人民銀行在港發行600億元人民幣半年期票據
zh.dek: 中國人民銀行一筆600億元人民幣半年期央行票據今日在港發行，上周招標超額認購逾一倍。
body: 香港金融管理局代中國人民銀行公布，人民銀行一筆600億元人民幣的半年期央行票據於今日在香港發行。
票據發行編號為BCHKFP26041，發行日期為2026年9月28日，到期日為2027年3月29日或最接近的付息日。招標已於9月23日進行。
是次申請總額達1,270.35億元人民幣，發行額為600億元人民幣。平均獲接納息率為1.30厘，獲接納息率介乎1.15厘至1.37厘。按最高獲接納息率計算，分配比例約為36.74%。
金管局代人民銀行公布上述結果。人民銀行定期在港發行人民幣央行票據，是管理離岸人民幣流動性的安排之一。
